topics.name: Rage-Baiting as Product Strategy
topics.summary: Host published essay 'Rage Baiting is for Losers' arguing Chad IDE/Clad Labs moved rage-bait from a fringe marketing tactic to a product-level strategy, undermining the coalition-building needed for startup success and putting YC's brand at risk.

topics.name: Microsoft Fairwater Data Center and AI Strategy
topics.summary: Satya Nadella's exclusive interview at Fairwater covered AGI vision, hyperscaler vs. single-customer strategies, reasons for Microsoft's data center 'pause,' chip depreciation debates, neocloud leasing, and MAI internal model training ambitions.

topics.name: Mega VC Fund LP Return Controversy
topics.summary: Everett Randles claimed on 20VC that A16Z and other mega-funds cannot credibly promise 5x net returns to LPs; sparked significant debate with Scott Kapoor's rebuttal and broad Twitter/X pile-on.

topics.name: AI Chip Depreciation Debate (Burry Thesis)
topics.summary: Michael Burry's thesis that hyperscalers are artificially boosting earnings by extending server/GPU useful life from 3-5 to 5-6 years was rebutted by Jordan Nanos using historical data showing V100s still in production 8 years later.

topics.name: AI Data Center Energy Infrastructure
topics.summary: Jordan Nanos previewed an upcoming Semi-Analysis energy model; discussion covered sold-out behind-the-meter turbines (Bloom, Vertiv, Schneider), regulatory hurdles, and Elon Musk's cross-border power plant strategy for data centers.

topics.name: Spatial Intelligence and 3D World Models
topics.summary: Dr. Fei-Fei Li discussed World Labs' launch of the first publicly available 3D world generation model; covered scaling law differences vs. LLMs, 3D data scarcity challenges, and horizontal use cases across VFX, gaming, robotics, and metaverse.

topics.name: Defense Tech Autonomy
topics.summary: Forterra's Scott Sanders discussed building distributed autonomous ground vehicles for defense; praised Pete Hegseth's acquisition reform and the push to replace humans as the front-line 'blunting force of combat' with autonomous platforms.

topics.name: Stablecoin and Crypto Infrastructure
topics.summary: Circle's Jeremy Allaire covered USDC's 108% YoY growth, ARC layer-1 blockchain launch, CCTP's cross-chain dominance, and accelerating global stablecoin regulation following the Genius Act; also discussed AI agent payment standards like X402.

topics.name: AI Agent Startups vs. SaaS Incumbents
topics.summary: Brian Halligan argued that unlike the client-server to SaaS transition (where incumbents were in denial), SaaS companies are aggressively building AI agents; agent-native startups have best opportunities in verticals without dominant SaaS players.

topics.name: Co-CEO and Stewardship Dynamics
topics.summary: Discussed Sequoia's appointment of Alfred Lynn and Pat Grady as co-stewards; Brian Halligan cited Netflix and Spotify as rare successful co-CEO examples but expressed general skepticism about the model's scalability.

topics.name: OpenAI GPT-5.1 Launch
topics.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5.1 Thinking and Instant to all users with no accompanying benchmarks; blog post focused on model personality rather than technical metrics, drawing criticism from observers like Neer.

topics.name: Tesla FSD V13 Review
topics.summary: Andrej Karpathy posted a glowing review of Tesla FSD V13 on HW4 hardware, calling it dramatically better than HW3 and describing highway performance as feeling like riding in a 'super high-tech maglev train pod.'

topics.name: CoreWeave Earnings
topics.summary: CoreWeave doubled revenue YoY but stock sold off ~26%; short-term CAPEX guidance revised due to Core Scientific's delay delivering only 150MW of 250MW promised; CEO cited Semi-Analysis Cluster Max platinum rating on CNBC.

topics.name: Decentralized Exchange Innovation
topics.summary: Lighter's Vlad discussed building a verifiable, low-latency DEX on Ethereum as a post-FTX alternative; argued centralized exchanges still lack the transparency the industry requires; raised new round with Robinhood Markets.

topics.name: Five-Tool CEO Archetype
topics.summary: Brian Halligan described a new breed of founder who can simultaneously code, design, sell, recruit, and cast vision; examples include Parker Conrad, Brett Taylor, and Mati from 11 Labs; noted they lack traditional CEO role models like Jobs or Bezos.

topics.name: Microsoft Pause in Data Center Build-Out
topics.summary: Jordan Nanos and hosts analyzed Semi-Analysis data showing Microsoft's dramatic flatlining of pre-leased data center capacity from 2023 onward; attributed to fungibility concerns, OpenAI concentration risk, and geopolitical data sovereignty issues.
